title: Cherrypicking PCR/qPCR preparation protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load deck and labware
steps.instruction: Place the 20 µL filter tipracks in slots 1, 4, and 7; put the 24‑tube rack (2 mL screw‑cap tubes) in slot 2 with mastermix in well A6; install the Temperature Module in slot 3 and set either a 96‑well PCR strip (Aluminum Block) or a NEST 100 µL PCR plate on it; arrange the 96‑well non‑binding surface microplates (or additional tube rack) in slots 5, 6, 8, and 11.

substeps.instruction: Load 20 µL filter tipracks into slots 1, 4, 7.
Load 24‑tube rack (2 mL screw‑cap) into slot 2; add mastermix to well A6.
Place PCR strip (Aluminum Block) or NEST 100 µL PCR plate onto the Temperature Module (slot 3).
Load non‑binding surface microplates or extra tube rack into slots 5, 6, 8, 11.

steps.title: Configure sample transfer
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, input the total number of samples (determines sequential mastermix distribution A1‑12, B1‑12, …), select the P20 single‑channel GEN2 pipette mount, choose the PCR plate on the Temperature Module as destination, and upload the CSV file containing source and destination well coordinates (or download the example CSV).

substeps.instruction: Select P20 single‑channel GEN2 pipette mount.
Select the PCR plate positioned on the Temperature Module.
Upload the sample‑transfer CSV (or download the example).

steps.title: Download and upload protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated Python protocol file and upload it to the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware, each tiprack, and the P20 pipette (follow the provided support articles for tips).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the cherrypicking PCR/qPCR preparation.
